kind.seq_scan: Seq Scan reads the whole table from start to end, page by page, and keeps the rows that match the condition.
kind.index_scan: Index Scan follows an index to find just the rows it needs, then jumps to the table to fetch them.
kind.index_only_scan: Index Only Scan answers from the index itself and skips the table when the index already holds every column needed.
kind.bitmap_scan: Bitmap Scan uses an index to collect the list of pages to read first, then reads those pages in one pass.
kind.nested_loop: Nested Loop takes each row of the outer table and probes the inner table for matching rows.
kind.hash_join: Hash Join builds a hash table from one table, then probes it with each row of the other table.
kind.merge_join: Merge Join sorts both sides by the join key, then slides two pointers side by side to pair up rows.
kind.hash: Hash builds an in-memory hash table from the rows it receives, for the join above it to probe.
kind.sort: Sort puts the incoming rows in the requested order.
kind.aggregate: Aggregate collapses many rows into fewer, for example counting or summing per group.
kind.limit: Limit keeps only the first requested number of rows and then stops.
kind.other: The engine reported this step and SQLLens has no plain-language note for it yet. See the engine's own name and the numbers.
